svg.aria-label: Hall of fame: Sourcify, within about a day; Ethernal, hosted service closed the same day; fixed in 5.19.5; Hookr, fixed in the next release; Priors, published 0 to 10 days after the report; QHooks, same day; Gloam, the last within hours; LoomDesk, same day; predict FWA, same day, before round 1; AgentCity, within a week, answered one by one; Stoa, same day; NOUNY, within the hour; Agraris, within the hour; Purser, within two hours; Agent402, same day; 1Shot, within days; Autonomo, same day; x402fi, same day
svg.text: Teams that fixed what we reported and said so in public, the largest projects first.

g.text: Three published: code execution on the verification
server, and two false Exact Matches for code that differs
Two published: an auth bypass when AUTH_SECRET was unset,
and a contract verification request that hung the backend
Two published: drop timing in first-release time shares,
and the launch wallet cap counted per contract
Eight published: StockVault, its price tape, borrowing,
the score, elizaOS, the Rialto route and the line board
A key-storage issue in how the quantum key was protected
Nine reports; eight now published as advisories: relay,
SDK, payments, proofs of funds, holder vote, cash out
Four gaps in the SDK's send gate
Two game-logic issues, found before launch
Five findings across the placement market, terms, key
Two Mediums: dust orders could block new limit orders, and
which Uniswap V4 pools the router uses
Three Lows in a review they asked for: weekend vault
creation, a payroll cap, the hook's per-block limit
Public listings could set their own GitHub stars, activity
and dates, and links accepted any URL scheme
Six published: an account that paid nothing, an open URL
fetch, a gas drain, Shield poisoning, a call check, a race
Two payment checks: x402 caps against the signed amount,
and a Stellar fallback that took any transfer
Embedded-wallet hardening: warnings a host could replace,
cross-site extension sessions, requester origin checks
The Borro borrow path signed every transaction in the
answer, outside the agent's spending caps
Three gateway and facilitator payment issues, published as

svg.text: A listing says the team handled a report well. It is not an audit and not a statement that the code is safe.
